draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and observational, describing a change in state or position
notes: Intransitive (taking -이/가). Its transitive counterpart is 떨어뜨리다 ('to drop something').
In the 'fail' sense, it takes the particle -에서 (시험에서 떨어지다) and its opposite is 붙다 ('to pass').
